claim_ceiling: CANDIDATE MECHANISM; nothing established for or against the mechanism by this run

correctness.intention_to_test: applies to provider failures, which are preserved as incorrect and cost-bearing; the 66 rows are not provider failures
correctness.reason: the sealed match rule presupposes an outcome drawn from the frozen enum; it contains no rule for a governed result the contract never defined, so scoring the 66 rows incorrect would extend the rule after outcomes were visible

deterministic_selection_contract.detail: selected modes and reason codes match the sealed expected modes on every row read; the mechanism selected as specified

economics.reason: section 17 permits economic adjudication only after completeness, hard gates and correctness non-inferiority all pass

evidence_basis.scope_limit: findings below are established on the rows actually read; no corpus-wide count is asserted

executability: the frozen T1 contract is not executable as frozen for Modes A and E; this is the second executability defect after the r2 finding

finding_1_provider_behavior.class: PROVIDER CONFIGURATION BEHAVIOR DEVIATION / availability limitation
finding_1_provider_behavior.detail: frozen configuration requests thinking_budget 0 and include_thoughts false and was passed on every call; the provider returned nonzero thoughts_token_count regardless
finding_1_provider_behavior.effect: thinking tokens bill at the output rate and enter provider_dollar_cost, the dominant term of the primary composite

finding_2_execution_binding_defect.detail: 32 Mode A rows emitted the governed Decision candidate_relationship_rejected and 34 Mode E rows emitted only a ProbeDecision; neither is a value of the frozen outcome enum, and no implemented deterministic path emits a final enum outcome for these modes
finding_2_execution_binding_defect.nnd_responsibility: NND flagged the Mode E interpretive gap and recommended the reading BHE ratified; neither party observed that the ratified reading leaves Mode E with no enum outcome
finding_2_execution_binding_defect.root_cause: C-6 and C-7 fixed the call schedule and the response envelope but never defined how Modes A and E produce a final adjudication outcome; the pre-execution review did not catch it

finding_3_arm_b_corpus_defect.detail: broad_context_case.case_file carries prose only and no fact identifiers, so Arm B could not cite evidence ids testable against ground_truth_evidence_ids
finding_3_arm_b_corpus_defect.effect: the evidence clause of the sealed match rule is structurally unsatisfiable for Arm B
finding_3_arm_b_corpus_defect.scope: secondary H1-vs-B comparison only; does not touch the primary H1-vs-H0 test

naming_caveat: section 18 defines INCONCLUSIVE for the case where gates and correctness pass and economics are indeterminate; here correctness itself is undeterminable, so neither frozen name fits cleanly. INCONCLUSIVE is selected because its function - the experiment could not adjudicate without itself demonstrating mechanism failure - describes this situation, and because the provider incompleteness clause is independently satisfied. The design owner may overrule.
why_not_falsified: hard gates are zero on every row read
the deterministic selection contract was honored exactly, which is the condition section 18 names for falsification
the failure is in the measurement instrument, not in the mechanism under test
recording FALSIFIED would enter a permanent negative claim about the mechanism that this evidence does not support
